relationship.description:
Relationship between the from vertex and the to vertex. E.g. Edge-coloring problem where different edges between the
same nodes can have different colors a.k.a 'relationships'

fromInfo.description: Additional info for the 'from' vertex can be stored here

toInfo.description: Additional info for the 'to' vertex can be stored here

involvement.description: Placeholder field. Not used in current computation.

isRoot.description: If the current edge stems from a root node (root node is one where vertex doesn't have any incident edges)

distance.description:
Distance of node 'from' to node 'to'. An immediate edge in the graph is always distance 1, similarly,
distance is always 0 if both the 'from' and the 'to' nodes are same.

versionNumber.description: Place holder field. Not being used in internal computation

versionEdits.description: Version edits field inherited from base type, not persisted in denormalized structure

name.description: Name field inherited from base type, not persisted in denormalized structure

meta.description: Metadata field inherited from base type, not persisted in denormalized structure

version.description: Version field inherited from base type, not persisted in denormalized structure

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

title:
Denormalized hierarchy structure for {@link Organization}s to enable efficient querying
of organizational relationships and hierarchies.

This type flattens hierarchical relationships from multiple sources including
{@link OrganizationRollup} and {@link CustomerRelation} into a single denormalized structure
for improved query performance.
name: OrganizationHierarchyDenorm
